summary: 550 Terry A. Francois Boulevard is a 6-story Class A office building in Mission Bay, built in 2002 per DataSF Assessor records; it was long the Gap Inc./Old Navy corporate headquarters, purchased by DivcoWest from Gap in 2022 and later subleased to OpenAI.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200010304349 filed to erect a six-story office building at 550 Terry A. Francois Blvd

sources.title: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (blklot 8721011, 550 Terry A. Francois Blvd): year_property_built 2002
Building Permits: permit #200010304349 (550 Terry A. Francois Blvd), filed 2000-10-30, "erect a six story office bldg", completed 2002-09-13
sources.publisher: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection

open_questions: Exact month/day of the 2002 completion is not sourced, only the year.

The 2000 permit's own block/lot references (spanning several small blocks in the 3839-3851 range, an older pre-redevelopment block grid) differ from the Assessor's current blklot 8721011; the address (550 Terry A. Francois Blvd), six-story office description, and 2002-09-13 permit-completion date (matching the Assessor's 2002 year exactly) line up with this parcel, so this is treated as Mission Bay's redevelopment-era block renumbering, not a different building.

The building's developer/architect (reported elsewhere as Studios Architecture) was not independently confirmed by a source read in this pass -- left out of this minimal dossier rather than repeated unsourced.
